ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 16 of 2012 (as amended); International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 13 of 2021, including beneficial ownership and registered agent due diligence provisions); Companies Act [Cap. 191]; Beneficial Ownership Regulations 2016; VFSC AML/CFT Rule No. 1 of 2018.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified full-color copy of passport of each shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the document holder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a contracting state to the Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961) OR Consular Legalization for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified bank reference letter confirming client identity and presumed source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or regulated financial institution in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or government-issued document dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or government authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate shareholder holding 25% or more of the International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, director, ultimate beneficial owner, and authorized signatory against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK/EU consolidated sanctions lists, and the VFSC domestic PEP list, supplemented by adverse-media, enforcement, and global watchlist checks. PEP status, including family members and close associates, triggers enhanced due diligence, verified source-of-funds documentation, and senior management approval under the AML/CFT regime. Any sanctions match is reportable to the VFSC within 24 hours and all transactional movement is frozen pending guidance from the competent authorities.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry e-Services Portal - Online International Company Name Reservation Module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in the Latin (Roman) alphabet; English and French are the official corporate languages. The name must be distinguishable, not misleading, and must end with an approved International Company suffix: 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Société Anonyme', or the abbreviations 'Ltd', 'Corp', 'Inc', 'SA'. Vernacular and customary names must be transliterated into the official bilingual standard and may be refused if they cannot be verified against the register.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Insurer, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Building Society, Financial Services, Securities, Fund Manager, Trust, Trustee (require prior licensing or express consent of the VFSC)
Government, Republic, Commonwealth, National, State, Ministry, Official, Municipal (imply governmental or Crown patronage)
Vanuatu, Ni-Vanuatu, Ombudsman, University, Chamber of Commerce (require a demonstrable connection or ministerial consent)
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, reserved name, or well-known foreign mark
Words contrary to public policy, morality, or customary respect (per International Companies Act [Cap. 222], s. 10-11)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The initial 30-day name reservation may be extended for one further 30-day period by re-submitting the name reservation request and paying the applicable VFSC renewal fee before expiry; failure to incorporate within the reservation window causes automatic lapse of the reservation. Upon receipt of a VFSC name rejection notice, the applicant, acting through its licensed registered agent, may file an administrative appeal on VFSC Form NC-APL within 14 calendar days, attaching: (a) the original rejection notice; (b) a revised name-search report; and (c) evidence of any prior ministerial or VFSC consent. The Registrar of International Companies must issue a written determination within 15 business days. An adverse determination may be challenged by judicial review in the Vanuatu Supreme Court; external legal costs are estimated at USD 1,500-3,000, excluding disbursements.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office in Vanuatu is mandatory for every International Company and must be maintained through a VFSC-licensed registered agent. A virtual-office arrangement comprising the licensed agent's physical address, mail forwarding, and digital correspondence is permissible for this low-risk, non-licensed SaaS activity, but a bare mailbox arrangement with no responsible agent is prohibited: the registered agent must hold physical custody of the statutory records and the beneficial ownership register and must remain contactable during business hours. Remote operational headquarters outside Vanuatu are permitted; no physical premises in Vanuatu are required for the SEO Content Analytics Tool business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - estimated at less than 5% probability per annum for a non-licensed, low-risk International Company with no physical presence in Vanuatu; VFSC inspection resources are directed primarily at licensed registered agents, financial dealers, and trust service providers rather than the premises of remote MarTech analytics SaaS operators.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222) of Vanuatu, Sections 5, 7, 12, 33, 48 and 54 (incorporation, memorandum and articles, registered office, officers, and share capital).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation) appended to the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement for a Vanuatu International Company; capital may be denominated in any currency, and no escrow deposit or bank confirmation is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the subscribers' share subscriptions and allotments as recorded in the share register be and are hereby ratified and accepted. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office of the Company be established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the agent be authorized to accept service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [Name] be and is hereby appointed as Director, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Authorized Representative of the Company, each to hold office until removed by resolution. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the officers are authorized to execute documents and open banking accounts to commence business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila (online submission via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed corporate names to the VFSC via a licensed registered agent for availability screening. Upon approval, pay the name reservation fee and confirm the approved name for use in the constitutive documents.
required_dossiers: Engagement letter with licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited wording, resubmit with the alternate name and an explanatory submission; VFSC decision is appealable to the Registrar within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (VFSC-approved corporate service provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act 1992, stating company name, registered office address, share structure, limited liability status, and object clause covering software development, data analytics, and digital marketing technology services.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries a clause, amend the affected article and resubmit through the registered agent; no fresh statutory filing fee is charged for a clerical amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Form IC-1, the Memorandum and Articles of Association, and the declarations of the first director and shareholder; file the complete submission electronically or in hard copy at the VFSC counter with the prescribed government fee of USD 350.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected or queried, the registered agent submits a response to the VFSC query letter within 14 days; incomplete documents may be cured by supplementary filing without restarting the process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect the Certificate of Incorporation, the certified Memorandum and Articles, and the Certificate of Good Standing; verify statutory details against the application before distribution.
required_dossiers: Government-filed copy of the Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, submit a formal rectification request to the Registrar; correction is issued within 5 business days at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (in person or by written resolution), adopt the first board resolution, issue share certificates, open the statutory register of members and directors, and resolve on the appointment of the registered agent and the opening of the corporate bank account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a statutory register is incomplete, rectify by supplementary entry and have the directors acknowledge the correction in the next board minute.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for corporate registration; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for investment incentives; no sectoral industrial board applies to ISIC 6201 software activities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - no operating license, manufacturing permit, or trade license is required for an International Company conducting ISIC 6201 SEO content analytics and software as a service; the Certificate of Incorporation is the sole constitutive authorization.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 4 administrative activity; no full EIA or environmental registration required for office-based SaaS and data analytics operations with no physical plant or extraction component.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generation; residual office waste must be transferred to a licensed municipal waste contractor in compliance with the Waste Management Act No. 24 of 2015 and the Waste Management Regulations 2015, with zero-discharge compliance recorded annually.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire and Safety Services for the Port Vila registered office; building occupancy permit for low-risk office use; no structural load inspection or industrial accident clearance applicable because the business operates no physical production facility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — https://www.vfsc.vu — registers International Companies; the Department of Finance and Treasury (VAT Office), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — https://www.finance.gov.vu — administers all indirect tax. No income-tax authority exists because Vanuatu levies no income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign founders appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila; the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the unique VFSC Company Number is the sole statutory identifier. No TIN or income-tax registration exists. VAT registration (Form 01 to the Commissioner of VAT, Section 5, VAT Act [Cap 293]) is inapplicable to a bona fide IC, which is barred from carrying on business in Vanuatu and is exempt from VAT. No central-bank approval or exchange-control clearance applies to foreign ownership or inbound capital.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone. Section 10, International Companies Act [Cap 222]: the IC is exempt from all income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, estate/inheritance tax, stamp duty and VAT on all transactions conducted under the Act. Conditionality: the IC must not carry on business in Vanuatu, transact with residents outside the IC framework, or own Vanuatu real estate; breach causes retroactive loss of exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu has no corporate income tax statute and therefore no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election. Exemption is automatic and unconditional. The only administrative options are voluntary VAT registration (inapt for an exempt IC) and migration/deregistration under the IC Act; neither creates tax liability absent a breach.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — VAT Act [Cap 293]; no GST, sales tax, or customs duty on digital services
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 in taxable supplies in any 12-month period (approx. USD 42,000); compulsory for domestic taxable activities; inapplicable to an exempt offshore IC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu does not mandate e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API filing, or digital stamping. The VAT Act requires only a Commissioner-approved tax invoice containing supplier name and VAT number, date, description, quantity, price, and VAT amount. Records must be kept in English, retained 7 years, and available in Vanuatu. The IC issues its own contractual invoices from its registered-office address, charging no Vanuatu VAT.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Section 48, VAT Act [Cap 293] zero-rates: (a) exports of goods with proof of physical export; (b) services to non-residents directly connected with exported goods; (c) services connected with movable property outside Vanuatu; and (d) international transport. SaaS SEO/content-analytics services supplied to non-resident customers for consumption wholly abroad qualify as exported services and would be zero-rated if within the VAT net; a bona fide IC is, however, outside the scope of the VAT Act entirely and charges no 12.5% VAT, the IC exemption superseding the zero-rating mechanism. Cross-border digital-services taxes in customer jurisdictions are collected by Stripe/Paddle as merchant-of-record payment facilitators — not by Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Vanuatu Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World entry) — needed only for physical exports; for pure SaaS no customs entry arises, and the functional substitute is the executed SaaS subscription agreement plus server-access or usage logs evidencing overseas consumption

Bill of Lading or Airway Bill — required only on a physical-goods export leg; for SEO analytics the equivalent evidence is the signed master service agreement/order form identifying the non-resident customer and the cloud-infrastructure hosting location

Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 or Stripe-Paddle payout settlement statements — evidencing foreign-currency receipt of export proceeds, reconcilable to the invoice ledger and customer base
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: An unsubstantiated zero-rating claim triggers default VAT assessment at 12.5% plus statutory interest, penalties up to twice the tax shortfall, fines up to VUV 500,000 and/or imprisonment for intentional false statements under the VAT Act. For an IC, the graver clawback is substantive: proof of local business, resident dealing, or registered-agent/office default forfeits the IC exemption retroactively, making all prior transactions taxable and exposing assets to court-ordered recovery. Vanuatu has no exchange-control statute; the 180-day figure reflects bank AML/KYC export-proceeds documentation benchmark practice, not a statutory repatriation deadline.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as the central bank and monetary authority, with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) acting as the licensing and AML/CFT supervisor for banks and financial service providers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains full capital and current account convertibility. There is no exchange control legislation and no requirement for prior RBV approval of capital injections, profit remittances, or subscription receipts. The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is freely convertible, and an International Company may denominate accounts and contracts in USD, EUR, AUD, or other currencies. Profit remittance is unrestricted by statute; the only substantive hurdles are bank-level source-of-funds due diligence and maintaining a valid registered agent and Good Standing certificate with VFSC. This yields a Tier-1 unrestricted convertibility profile for a cross-border SaaS exporter.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender rules. SaaS subscription and SEO analytics export receipts may be retained indefinitely in any convertible currency, and there is no mandated conversion timeline or mandatory conversion ratio into VUV. Receipts are subject only to ordinary bank recordkeeping and the Vanuatu AML/CFT suspicious transaction reporting regime, with no central bank form filing for export proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account (Capital Escrow Account generally limited to domestic or higher-risk profiles)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. Vanuatu has no recognised e-money institution (EMI) or dedicated digital EMI licensing category. An unlicensed offshore EMI seeking to hold or transmit client funds would constitute unauthorised financial business under the Vanuatu Financial Services Framework, which creates immediate regulatory and banking-risk exposure. Offshore EMI settlement rails are therefore not a viable substitute for a VFSC-licensed bank account. The preferred architecture is to use regulated SaaS payment acquirers (Stripe and Paddle) for commercial receipts and an RBV-licensed commercial bank as the underlying treasury settlement account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Neither the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu nor VFSC imposes a universal statutory requirement for physical director appearance. RBV-licensed banks are permitted to complete remote onboarding using video identification, certified identity documents, and enhanced due diligence for non-resident corporate clients. In practice, most Vanuatu banks require at least one live video or physical interview with the ultimate beneficial owner before account opening, but this is a compliance procedure rather than a legal mandate. A notarised copy of the director's passport and a certified corporate registry extract are generally sufficient in conjunction with the interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity — nominee shareholding or undisclosed ultimate beneficial owner names in the International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full share certificate chain from the VFSC-registered agent, signed trust declaration, certified passport or nationality identity card of each natural-person UBO, registered agent certificate, no-liability confirmation, corporate registry search result, and a director's signed letter confirming direct share ownership with no undisclosed nominees.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sourced funds arriving via third-party payment platforms (Stripe/Paddle) without an explicit commercial invoice trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export service agreements with itemised SEO analytics subscription terms, monthly Stripe and Paddle settlement statements, platform AML/KYC attestation letters, sample transaction-level customer records, anonymised billing summaries, and a letter from the external accountant reconciling platform payouts to the bank statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border wires to or from high-risk jurisdictions or any sanctions-listed counterparty
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Screened inbound and outbound ledger reports, SWIFT MT103 copies, sanctions and PEP screening results from an independent compliance database, geographic end-customer breakdown, contractual clauses prohibiting re-export of SaaS services to sanctioned territories, and a bank-format source-of-funds declaration signed by the beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection into escrow followed by immediate large disbursements without an operating cycle
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorising the capital contribution and disbursement plan, audited or accountant-confirmed opening balance sheet, business plan with subscriber and revenue forecasts, source-of-funds evidence from the sending bank, and a current Good Standing certificate issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections are routed via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home bank to the Vanuatu IC operating account with the payment reference 'Capital Injection – VU_IC / ISIC 6201 / SEO CONTENT ANALYTICS TOOL' and the beneficiary account number. Vanuatu does not mandate a national balance-of-payments code, but the bank requires the payment to be clearly labelled as equity contribution so it can be distinguished from trade proceeds under its internal AML reporting. The bank also requires a signed board resolution, a source-of-funds declaration, and the registered agent certificate before accepting the credit. Funds are initially held in a Capital Escrow Account until Compliance clears the UBO profile.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for SaaS licensing fees, infrastructure subscriptions, vendor invoices, and foreign professional fees are settled by SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers from the Vanuatu IC operating account. For larger contract settlements involving physical goods or service licensing, an RBC-licensed commercial bank may issue a documentary Commercial Letter of Credit using the SWIFT MT700 issuance and MT742 reimbursement message sequence. Card acquirer payout rails from Stripe and Paddle remit settled funds directly to the same IC bank account, preserving a fully auditable inbound and outbound clearing trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu vatu forward contracts (USD/VUV and AUD/VUV) with an RBV-licensed bank
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) booked offshore for non-deliverable currency exposure
Cross-currency swaps between VUV/USD and USD/EUR for subscription revenue matching
Vanuatu vatu currency options and zero-cost collars for EBITDA conversion protection
Synthetic forward hedging via Stripe and Paddle settlement in USD with bank treasury conversion to VUV

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual licence fee renewal for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) / Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation; payment due no later than 30 days after the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a late-payment penalty; continued non-payment for 12 months may result in administrative strike-off and forfeiture of assets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual return confirming registered office, registered agent and directors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file within the prescribed window renders the company liable to a late-filing penalty; persistent non-filing triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from independent audit and from preparation or filing of audited financial statements. No turnover or balance-sheet threshold triggers a mandatory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed for International Companies. If financial statements are prepared voluntarily, management may adopt IFRS or a suitable local GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation or public beneficial ownership register exists. Shareholding transfers are recorded in the Register of Members maintained at the registered office, and no separate annual confirmation filing is required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 0 - not required (audit-exempt); if voluntarily audited, USD 1,500 - 3,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; the Income Tax Act is functionally dormant for CIT purposes, and an International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes on offshore income under s.4 of the International Companies Act Cap 222.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total exemption from corporate income tax, dividend withholding tax, interest and royalty withholding tax, capital gains tax, payroll tax, and stamp duty on offshore transactions. The only fixed costs are the VFSC annual government fee (VT 25,000), registered agent fee, and annual ESR compliance costs. There are no CFC rules, thin capitalisation rules, or controlled-foreign-corporation attribution provisions applicable to an International Company.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Summary Return (ASR) for International Companies — filed online through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Compliance e-Portal at https://www.vfsc.vu; no corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, due within one calendar month after the anniversary of the date of incorporation (s.283, International Companies Act Cap 222).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by the last day of the month immediately following the incorporation anniversary; late submission attracts a VT 25,000 automatic surcharge and escalating risk of strike-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company name, original VFSC registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact VFSC certificate designation; a name mismatch with the Stripe or Paddle merchant application will trigger mid-stream KYB re-verification and payment hold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Registered office and registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical Vanuatu registered office address and the name and contact details of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must hold a Vanuatu licence; this address is the sole formal service-of-process point for offshore litigation and statutory notices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, residential addresses, and nationality of each director.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors are strongly disfavoured; ESR assessments look at factual control. A non-resident beneficial owner acting as de facto director should be disclosed to avoid a false-declaration offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, and percentage shareholding of each registered shareholder and any natural-person ultimate beneficial owner.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Vanuatu's beneficial ownership regime (2021) requires International Companies to file UBO particulars with VFSC; non-disclosure exposes the company to penalties up to VT 10,000,000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, class of shares, number of shares, and par value.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital exists; a fractionally paid capital structure is acceptable under the IC Act but must match the bank and merchant-of-record onboarding declarations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration confirming that the company has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents, has not owned freehold land in Vanuatu, and remains eligible for international company status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Falsely declaring eligibility while service revenue originates from Vanuatu-based customers breaches s.6 of the International Companies Act and triggers loss of the tax-exempt status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late ASR: VT 25,000 automatic surcharge; continued default leads to VFSC removal notice and strike-off, asset vesting in VFSC custody, and termination of the registered agent's mandate. The agent will usually resign before strike-off, rendering the entity ungovernable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ESR01 Economic Substance Notification and ESR02 Economic Substance Report — Vanuatu Economic Substance (Regulations) Act 2019; both filed through the VFSC ESR online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. ESR01 is due within one month after the end of the financial period; ESR02 is due within 12 months after the end of the financial period.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a 31 December financial year-end, ESR01 must be filed by 31 January and ESR02 by 31 December of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal entity name, VFSC registration number, financial period start and end dates, and registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The financial period may differ from the incorporation anniversary; maintain a reconciliation note where a foreign parent reporting currency differs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tick applicable relevant activities: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, distribution and service centre, and intellectual property business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A SaaS SEO and keyword analytics platform deriving subscription, licence, or residual API fees must classify as an intellectual property (IP) business if income is generated from software IP. The IP category attracts the strictest substance evaluation under the ESR regime.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 3 — Gross income by relevant activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income attributable to each relevant activity, reported in Vatu-equivalent, with a geographic breakdown of where the income arose.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross recurring revenue routed through Stripe or Paddle Merchant-of-Record arrangements; do not net platform fees or cloud compute costs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 — Operating expenditure incurred in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Research and development, data-centre oversight, employee, professional, and infrastructure expenditure physically incurred in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Outsourced AWS or Google Cloud hosting and offshore development teams do not constitute Vanuatu CIGA. The entity must prove local payroll, decision-making, and data-governance functions, not merely invoice coverage.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Headcount, functions, and qualifications of employees engaged in the core income-generating activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IP-business category prohibits outsourcing to non-Vanuatu third parties; local qualified staff must perform the core IP development and exploitation functions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 — Location of core income-generating activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Geographic address where the board takes key commercial decisions and where intellectual property development, exploitation, and risk assumption occur.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Hold board meetings physically in Port Vila or Luganville, retain signed minutes, and maintain a local director with demonstrable involvement. Remote-only or fabricated board meetings are a documented ESR failure indicator.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the entity satisfies the economic substance test, including a combined evaluation of income, expenditure, employees, and premises in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Knowingly filing a false substance declaration is a criminal offence. If the entity fails the test, file the declaration of failure together with an intended corrective-action statement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or late ESR01/ESR02: entity penalty up to VT 10,000,000 and continuing daily penalties; officers liable to a fine up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to two years. Non-compliant entities are additionally reported to the OECD Global Forum, materially increasing correspondent-banking and payment-processor KYB refusal risk.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — no dividend withholding tax exists in Vanuatu. An International Company may distribute dividends, return capital, and redeem shares free of Vanuatu withholding tax, capital gains tax, or exchange-control approval, without restriction on foreign currency settlement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network; only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) exist. A tax residency certificate cannot be issued for treaty purposes because the IC has no Vanuatu income tax charge. Foreign-payer withholding must therefore be eliminated structurally: characterise subscription income as business profits rather than royalties; use a Merchant-of-Record model (Stripe or Paddle) so the sale is sourced in the consumer jurisdiction; and rely on the payer jurisdiction's domestic sourcing rules rather than any Vanuatu treaty claim.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic Vanuatu rate on outbound royalties and interest: 0%. Treaty rates: not applicable because no DTAs exist. Primary exposure arises from customer-jurisdiction sourcing rules, e.g., 30% US-source FDAP withholding on software royalties absent a trade-or-business posture, and EU VAT on e-services. The ESR IP regime functionally requires the IC to demonstrate real Vanuatu substance to justify receiving royalty-type income from related entities.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No local transfer pricing statute or documentation threshold applies because no corporate income tax exists. However, the ESR framework functionally imports OECD transfer pricing principles: a Vanuatu IC acting as a low-substance IP owner of the SEO analytics technology will be deemed to lack economic substance unless it demonstrates local people, premises, and expenditure commensurate with the intercompany royalty receivable. For any IC with an intercompany principal or limited-risk model, benchmarked master file and local file documentation is prudently prepared once gross annual revenue exceeds VT 10,000,000 (approximately USD 85,000) or once royalty inflows from a related party exceed USD 500,000, mirroring the OECD DEMPE analysis.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance (Regulations) Act 2019 applies to International Companies. The SEO content analytics software platform is the highest-risk category: any income derived from proprietary software, algorithms, keyword-data crawlers, trademarked brand use, or licence streams is an intellectual property (IP) business, which cannot rebut the presumption of low substance by outsourcing to foreign affiliates. Compliance requires: (i) board meetings and strategic IP decisions held in Vanuatu; (ii) a physical office with contemporaneous records; (iii) adequate qualified full-time employees resident in Vanuatu performing product development, deployment oversight, and data governance; (iv) local operating expenditure commensurate with IP-generated gross income; and (v) annual ESR01 and ESR02 filings. A pure equity holding classification is available only if the IC passively holds the SaaS-IP subsidiary; active use of the software in sales disqualifies passive holding treatment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation of International Company status / unlawful domestic business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling SaaS subscriptions, trials, or local support to any Vanuatu resident or carrying on business within Vanuatu contrary to s.6 of the International Companies Act Cap 222, or owning or leasing Vanuatu land, while continuing to claim the IC tax exemption and VFSC status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC forfeits its tax-exempt status and becomes liable to 12.5% VAT on local supplies, business licence fees, and customs duties; VFSC may impose compliance penalties and strike the company off after three months of default, activating the asset-vesting provisions of the IC Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director signing a false ASR declaration faces a fine up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to two years; the Ministry of Finance may pursue civil restitution including clawback of distributed tax-free profits plus statutory interest.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing ESR01/ESR02 declaring full Vanuatu substance while all engineering, cloud infrastructure, product design, sales, and management functions are performed offshore; operating from a PO box, maintaining no local payroll, and fabricating board minutes post-hoc.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Entity penalty up to VT 10,000,000 plus continuing daily penalties; mandatory exchange-of-information disclosure to OECD member tax authorities; de-risking and account closure by correspondent banks and payment processors including Stripe and Paddle KYB refusal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Senior officers liable to a fine up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to two years; directors face disqualification orders under the Companies Act and travel bans under AML/CFT provisions where money laundering or tax evasion predicates are alleged.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: VAT evasion via direct consumer sales
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Supplying SaaS SEO tools to final customers in OECD jurisdictions through self-billing rather than a registered Merchant of Record; failing to collect and remit local VAT, GST, or e-services taxes (EU VAT on e-services, Australian GST, NZ GST, Singapore GST); or falsely declaring the supply as an offshore B2B service.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In each customer jurisdiction, the prior-year tax liability plus penalties up to 100% of the tax evaded, statutory interest, and merchant-account termination by payment platforms. Because no Vanuatu CIT offset exists, all offshore indirect tax exposure remains with the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be pursued by foreign tax authorities through civil garnishment and administrative co-operation; where VAT fraud is established, the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit can act on mutual legal assistance requests, resulting in account seizure, travel bans, and extradition exposure under the Extradition Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using nominee shareholders without disclosing the ultimate beneficial owner to VFSC; failing to file beneficial ownership particulars under Vanuatu's 2021 beneficial ownership regime; or transacting crypto or fiat flows inconsistent with the stated low-risk MarTech profile.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Entity fine up to VT 10,000,000 for UBO non-compliance; VFSC power to suspend financial services permissions; daily default fines for continued non-filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual officers face fines up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to two years; personal director accounts used for company fund flows may be frozen; directors face five-year banking debarment and immigration-related travel bans where money-laundering indicators arise.
